title: packet-cosem: use expert info instead of asserting
description:
In `packet-cosem.c`, remove all calls to `DISSECTOR_ASSERT_HINT()`.
Instead provide descriptive expert infos for the situations where
assertions were being raised:

* For `dlms_dissect_access_request_specification()` when the field
  `dlms.access_request` has a value that isn't between 1 and 5
* For `dlms_set_data_value()` when it's asked to give a label to a
  value which isn't actually a planar data type

In `dlms_dissect_access_request_specification()` use
`proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint()` instead of separate `tvb_get_uint8()`
and `proto_tree_add_item()` calls.

In `dlms_set_data_value()` replace the a series of `else if`s
with a `case` statement.

Fixes #20808
